scope: Future corrected candidate. All statuses intentionally not-run; baseline observations are separate.

cases.title: First section visit
cases.steps: Type at the bottom of Details, then enter Support and Connections by pointer and keyboard.
cases.expected: First meaningful heading/field visible; draft unchanged.

cases.title: Revisit and Back
cases.steps: Scroll each section, inspect a reference, use Back and revisit sections.
cases.expected: Section-specific or deliberately reset position; no offset borrowed from a different panel.

cases.title: Validation takes precedence
cases.steps: Create an error and an unfinished route/consumer; Apply from another section.
cases.expected: Relevant section and completion/error control revealed; no blanket reset hiding it.

cases.title: Fail then fix
cases.steps: Refuse Save through invalid field or unfinished connection, fix, Apply, Save.
cases.expected: Persisted intended data; no stale failed-Apply message.

cases.title: Preserve real unrelated failures
cases.steps: Cause Apply success followed by file/export failure; repair only one condition.
cases.expected: Accurate partial success; unresolved error not cleared by unrelated input.

cases.title: Session feedback
cases.steps: Complete export, New/Open/demo, and a delayed old-session export.
cases.expected: Status reset or source-qualified; no implication that old output represents the new dataset.

cases.title: Dependent proposal review
cases.steps: Remove an added target referenced by one or more merge proposals.
cases.expected: Exact consequences visible before commit; no premature collateral removal.

cases.title: Cancel and one Undo
cases.steps: Cancel the consequence step, then accept it; Undo and Redo.
cases.expected: Cancel preserves all; one Undo restores the accepted removal set.

cases.title: Stale consequence plan
cases.steps: Change relevant proposal set between plan presentation and acceptance using a controlled event.
cases.expected: Replan/refuse stale intent; no unreviewed dependent changes removed.

cases.title: Unrelated draft retained
cases.steps: Have pending scenario metadata/builder input while removing another committed change.
cases.expected: Explicit existing ownership semantics; unrelated pending work is not silently applied or discarded.

cases.title: Pinned arrangement
cases.steps: Open provided demo arrangement and Fit at 1024x768, 1366x768, 1600x1000, 1920x1080.
cases.expected: Readable/separable network and CDS headings; compare actual native fonts.

cases.title: Repeat initial layout
cases.steps: Open fictional demo repeatedly from fresh sessions and inspect laptop Fit.
cases.expected: No reliance on one favorable random layout; title bounds and visual review pass.

cases.title: No data-side layout changes
cases.steps: Resize, zoom, focus, return and capture the same arrangement.
cases.expected: No unwanted position/history/save-state mutations; endpoints and markings intact.

cases.title: Capture legibility
cases.steps: PNG/SVG for As-Is, To-Be, Compare and focus at briefing scale.
cases.expected: No heading/caption collisions; deliberate viewport cropping remains distinct from clipping.

cases.title: Generic Add focus
cases.steps: Add organization and each other non-service entity using keyboard.
cases.expected: Meaningful focus remains in summary; F2 continues when appropriate.

cases.title: Apply and Cancel focus
cases.steps: Apply changes and cancel a clean/dirty editor; exercise Stay.
cases.expected: Completion/return focus intentional; raw draft retained when staying.

cases.title: No focus stealing
cases.steps: Background relation refresh while typing, service-section restoration, reference peek return.
cases.expected: Focus only changes for an intentional user transition or error reveal.

cases.title: Notice file selection
cases.steps: Fixture packages with real LICENSE/NOTICE/AUTHORS and license-update.mjs.
cases.expected: Real notices retained, maintenance source excluded, absent required license fails build.

cases.title: Rendered notices
cases.steps: Inspect and keyboard-close offline notices page.
cases.expected: No executable maintenance source; text escaping and all required attribution remain.

cases.title: Build and distribution distinction
cases.steps: Compare public release metadata, Pages deployment and candidate identity.
cases.expected: Docs label preview/main vs released download accurately; no unauthorized tag/release.

cases.title: Prior workflow preservation
cases.steps: Replay important routes from the 154 independent checks and existing repository suite.
cases.expected: Inline creation, aggregate edits, Save, pending inspection, imports, Undo, focus and typed navigation preserved.

cases.title: Native file acceptance
cases.steps: Use approved Windows Edge/Chrome and exact standalone HTML with real OS files.
cases.expected: Save/Save As/cancel/refusal, recovery/readback and external-writer cases evidenced; no mocked-only closure.

cases.title: Real zoom and assistive technology
cases.steps: Exercise real 200/400-percent zoom, keyboard-only task and a supported screen reader.
cases.expected: No clipped required actions; sensible announcements, order and focus; report exact limitations.

cases.title: Uncoached receiving engineer
cases.steps: Use the participant protocol with an arriving solutions engineer and a briefing recipient.
cases.expected: Observe task completion, confusion, recovery and understanding of pending/applied/saved state; no fabricated participants.

cases.title: Exact delivered artifact
cases.steps: Build final candidate; hash and read back retained/downloaded bytes; run intended delivery path.
cases.expected: Report and acceptance tied to exact build; release only with owner authority.
